items.source: Set the year to the value resolved by following the given field reference.
items.translation: 将年份设置为通过遵循给定的字段引用解析的值。

items.source: Set the year to the result of the given expression.
items.translation: 将年份设置为给定expression的结果。

items.source: Set the year to the given value which must resolve to a calendar year.
items.translation: 将年份设置为给定值，该值必须解析为日历年份。

items.source:
AggregationExpression for $dateFromParts.
NOTE: Requires MongoDB 3.6 or later.
items.translation:
AggregationExpression 用于 $dateFromParts。
注意：需要 MongoDB 3.6 或更高版本。

items.source: Set the day to the value resolved by following the given field reference.
items.translation: 将日期设置为通过遵循给定的字段引用解析的值。

items.source: Set the day to the result of the given expression.
items.translation: 将日期设置为给定expression的结果。

items.source: Set the month to the value resolved by following the given field reference.
items.translation: 将月份设置为通过遵循给定的字段引用解析的值。

items.source: Set the month to the result of the given expression.
items.translation: 将月份设置为给定expression的结果。

items.source: Optionally set the DateOperators.Timezone to use.
items.translation: 可选地设置要使用的DateOperators.Timezone。

items.source: Set the day to the given value which must resolve to a calendar day in range 1 - 31.
items.translation: 将日期设置为给定值，该值必须解析为范围 1 - 31 内的日历日。

items.source: Set the month to the given value which must resolve to a calendar month in range 1 - 12.
items.translation: 将月份设置为给定值，该值必须解析为 1 到 12 之间的日历月份。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。
DateOperators.DateFromParts 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 包中的用途
